tributeSays.line: ⛓️ Junior brings it home: Ashford bows to Haven — one organization, us primary. Tribute: 4,000 kcal/week. The relationship starts at trust 30. Everything from here is earned.
🌾 Tribute wagons from Ashford turn at the gate — our shelves are full past tomorrow. "Eat well," we send back. "That IS your tribute this week." (Trust +1.)
